author: playerecho-com
body:
If you can't handle them you can use the "Sleep" spell to put the bosses asleep and than try to take them down. This will help you through the first few kills until you get better equip. Some bosses may be immune but many can be tackled like this.

also you may find some other useful tips here: [https://playerecho.com/orna/beginner-guide](https://playerecho.com/orna/beginner-guide)

author: neatcleaver
body:
Gear is more important than classes, make sure your gear is up to date and you are using Tier 6 weapons/armour

If you get a good weapon (I'd say legendary or ornate quality) at tier 6 don't feel bad about upgrading it a little. Use whetstones for a free level 3 then upgrade to level 4 overnight and it should be good enough

author: Krozz_08
body:
Ggs

A T6 build for a mage is fairly easy, you need 2 monsters, 3 if you count the accessories 

Carman (T6 boss) for staff and scroll
Arcane Dragon (T6 Monster) for Armor (head, torso, boots)
Ancient Cyclops (T6 Monster) for amulets

Everything in ornate, legendary minimum, level it up if you can to 10, if not, 6 is fine. That gives you decent durability and damage

For Monuments you'll need everything in lv 10
